content: Human-labeling session — combat-kite-jeep-vs-tank:hard seed 1. Objective: Commander, this is a kiting engagement against a hunting enemy heavy tank. You are given 3 fast medium-tank raiders at one of two corridors — NORTH (y=10) or SOUTH (y=30) — chosen by seed. The enemy heavy tank starts at (80,20) on the mid latitude and actively closes on whichever corridor you spawn in. The cannon out-trades raider weapons at close range. Fire from range, then retreat: when the heavy enters seven cells, move your raiders away along the lane; otherwise fire from range. All three raiders must survive, within about 40 turns.
